approved_recipe_contracts.fixed_mass_packet_basis: One gaseous formula-unit packet is 250 mB.
approved_recipe_contracts.exact_material_purpose: Consume a bounded carbon-monoxide gas stream by complete oxidation into carbon dioxide inside PNCR containment; this is a specific toxic/combustible-gas treatment sink, not a generic molecule conversion or graph-adjacency route.

approved_recipe_contracts.required_runtime_oracle: Fresh capture must prove exact recipe registration, 500 mB CO plus 250 mB O2 consumption, 500 mB CO2 delivery to a contained destination, and the uncontained escape behavior at the gas boundary.
